changes: Dense elliptical grass tufts and families assembled from individual 4.5-7cm narrow two-face cards. Small rooted photographic tufts replace wide whole-meadow cutouts. Moderate authored height differences, soft irregular edges and partial low-grass companions. Shared anchors and bends across mesh LODs; artist-authored weeds and shrubs retained.

meadow.atlas: Four small rooted photographic tufts from the original 4K atlas, packed into shared 1024x512 RGBA. Card width 4.5-7cm, independent of height. Each card has two connected tilted faces and upward lighting normals; no grass normal or AO map.
